concerns.location: tasks.md:T002, T010 vs constitution.md:Principle III / plan.md:Data Hygiene Gate
concerns.text: No task records checksums for downloaded/processed data or implements the plan's 'Data Hygiene Gate' (pipeline fails if data/raw missing or checksums mismatch). T002 downloads ENCODE files but its deliverables/verification omit checksum recording in state/; T010's end-to-end re-run never verifies checksums. Constitution Principle III and plan.md both mandate this, so an implementer following tasks.md alone cannot satisfy it.

Constitution VI requires 'total runtime per cell line must not exceed 2 hours' with profiling logs verifying compliance, but T005's verification only checks 'RAM < 7 GB and runtime < 6 h' total. No task asserts the per-cell-line 2-hour bound from the profiling log.

Constitution VII requires biological interpretation to be 'documented in the `interpretation/` directory', but T008 writes only `docs/regulatory_insights_report.md`. Either a task must produce the interpretation/ artifact or the constitution location must be reconciled; as written, no task covers this mandated deliverable location.

T002 cites the malformed URL 'https://ftp.eensembl.org/' alongside the correct 'ftp.ebi.ac.uk' GENCODE mirror, leaving the canonical gene-coordinate source ambiguous (constitution Principle I: same canonical source every run).
